revision.comment: 各国の式内社表の掲載。ただし、式内比定社は現在名神大社のみの状態、国史見在社・式外社も未掲載の状態。
revision.text:
'''出羽国の式内社一覧'''（でわのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[出羽国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社2座2社（いずれも名神大社）・小社7座7社の計9座9社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[飽海郡]]''' 3座（大2座・小1座） |- |'''大物忌神社'''||オホモノイミノ||名神大||||[[鳥海山大物忌神社]]||[[山形県]][[飽海郡]][[遊佐町]]||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/280101.html] |- |'''小物忌神社'''||ヲモノイミノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''月山神社'''||ツキヤマ||名神大||||[[鳥海山大物忌神社]]
（論）[[月山神社]]本宮||山形県飽海郡遊佐町
山形県[[東田川郡]][[庄内町]]||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/280301.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[田川郡]]''' 3座（並小） |- |'''遠賀神社'''||ヲカノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''由豆佐売神社'''||ユツサヒメノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''伊弖波神社'''||イテハノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[平鹿郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |'''塩湯彦神社'''||シホユヒコノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''波宇志別神社'''||ハウシワケノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[山本郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''副川神社'''||ソヒカハノ||小|||||||||| |} {{-}} {{節stub}} == 式外社 == 当時すでに存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社。 === 国史見在社 === [[六国史]]に記載のある式外社。 {{節stub}} === その他 === 国史見在社以外の式外社。 {{節stub}} == 参考文献 == * 皇典講究所・全国神職会校訂[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年） - 近代デジタルライブラリー * [http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1273537 『延喜式 第2』]（日本古典全集刊行会、昭和4年） - 近代デジタルライブラリー == 外部リンク == * [http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjastate28.html 出羽国 式内社9座]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」） {{式内社一覧}} [[Category:出羽国の式内社|*]]

'''出羽国の式内社一覧'''（でわのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[出羽国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社2座2社（いずれも名神大社）・小社7座7社の計9座9社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）

2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。

1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" '''出羽国の式内社一覧'''（でわのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[出羽国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。
また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。

'''出羽国の式内社一覧'''（でわのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[出羽国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。
また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。
== 式内社 == {{節stub}} 『延喜式』神名帳では、大社2座2社（いずれもMyojin Taisha社）・小社7座7社の計9座9社を記載。

{{afc comment|1=Switching over to deprecating the templates. So things might be a bit unexpected.[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=If this is in the format "List of Shikinaisha in X" then I have linked all existing shrines into the table. Otherwise I have not. Translation of the texts will come later as it is a lot less difficult than the tables. Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''出羽国の式内社一覧'''（でわのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[出羽国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。
また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。

== 式外社 == {{節stub}} 『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが、同帳に記載の無い神社。 * [[城輪神社]]:『[[日本三代実録]]卷第十』「城輪神」とされる<ref group="脚注" name=sandai>[[貞観 (日本)|貞観]]7年[[2月27日 (旧暦)|2月27日]]（[[865年]][[3月28日]]）条「出羽国正六位上城輪神。高泉神並従五位下」</ref>。 * [[古四王神社]]:『日本三代実録卷第十』「高泉神」とされる<ref group="脚注" name=sandai/>。

On enwiki if you want the templates extract them out of this page to make templates, The jawiki system is too hard[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:35, 31 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=page target for move is at List of Shikinaisha in Dewa Province[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:49, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=page target for move is at [[List of Shikinaisha in Dewa Province]] - [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=page target for move is at List of Shikinaisha in Dewa Province[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Switching over to deprecating the templates. So things might be a bit unexpected.[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=If this is in the format "List of Shikinaisha in X" then I have linked all existing shrines into the table. Otherwise I have not. Translation of the texts will come later as it is a lot less difficult than the tables. Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''出羽国の式内社一覧'''（でわのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[出羽国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。
また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。

revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Dewa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Dewa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Dewa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.
== Shikinai Shrines (式内社) ==
In the Engishiki, a list of major Shinto shrines is recorded – 2 groups (2 shrines, both of which are {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|Myojin Taisha|zh|Myojin Taisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha|qq=}}) and 7 groups (7 minor shrines) for a total of 9 groups, 9 shrines.

revision.comment: Text replacement - "Shikinai Shrines" to "Shikinaisha"
revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Dewa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Dewa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Dewa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.
== Shikinaisha (式内社) ==
In the Engishiki, a list of major Shinto shrines is recorded – 2 groups (2 shrines, both of which are {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|Myojin Taisha|zh|Myojin Taisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha|qq=}}) and 7 groups (7 minor shrines) for a total of 9 groups, 9 shrines.

revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Dewa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Dewa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Dewa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.
== Shikinaisha (式内社) ==
In the Engishiki, a list of major Shinto shrines is recorded – 2 groups (2 shrines, both of which are {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|Myojin Taisha|zh|Myojin Taisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha|qq=}}) and 7 groups (7 minor shrines) for a total of 9 groups, 9 shrines.

revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Dewa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Dewa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Dewa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.
== Shikinaisha (式内社) ==
In the Engishiki, a list of major Shinto shrines is recorded – 2 groups (2 shrines, both of which are {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|Myojin Taisha|zh|Myojin Taisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha|qq=}}) and 7 groups (7 minor shrines) for a total of 9 groups, 9 shrines.

revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Dewa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Dewa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Dewa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.
== Shikinaisha (式内社) ==
In the Engishiki, a list of major Shinto shrines is recorded – 2 groups (2 shrines, both of which are {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|Myojin Taisha|zh|Myojin Taisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha|qq=}}) and 7 groups (7 minor shrines) for a total of 9 groups, 9 shrines.

revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Dewa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Dewa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Dewa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.
== Shikinaisha (式内社) ==
In the Engishiki, a list of major Shinto shrines is recorded – 2 groups (2 shrines, both of which are {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|Myojin Taisha|zh|Myojin Taisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha|qq=}}) and 7 groups (7 minor shrines) for a total of 9 groups, 9 shrines.

revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Dewa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[:en:Dewa Province|Dewa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} of [[:en:Dewa Province|Dewa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.
== Shikinaisha (式内社) ==
In the Engishiki, a list of major Shinto shrines is recorded – 2 groups (2 shrines, both of which are {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|Myojin Taisha|zh|Myojin Taisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) and 7 groups (7 minor shrines) for a total of 9 groups, 9 shrines.

'''{{ill|Dewa no Shikinaisha Ichiran|de|Dewa no Shikinaisha Ichiran|ja|出羽国の式内社一覧|zh|出羽国の式内社一覧|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dewa no Shikinaisha Ichiran|qq=}}''' (Dewa no Kuni no Shikinaisha Ichiran) is a list of [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shrine]] – that is, the shrines recorded in the 9th and 10th volumes of the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}} (“Kamimyōchō Jōge”) – in addition to those shrines designated as {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|2=ja|3=式内社|qq=draft|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|2=ja|3=式内社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinaisha|13=User:Immanuelle|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|lt=Shikinaisha}} and their corresponding {{ill|Candidate Shrines|de|Kandidatschreine|ja|論社|1=candidate shrines|2=ja|3=論社|lt=candidate|zh|論社|1=candidate shrines|2=ja|3=論社|lt=candidate|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Candidate Shrines|13=User:Immanuelle/candidate shrines|1=Engishiki_Jinmyōchō#Ronsha|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki_Jinmyocho|lt=Ronsha}}}} that are classified as part of [[:en:Dewa Province|Dewa Province]].
It also includes shrines which, although they existed at the time of the compilation of the [[:en:Engishiki|Engishiki]], are not recorded in its Kamimyōchō – the so‐called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigai Shrines|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}”.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q11395784]] Wikidata name: (none) [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:53, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Dewa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[:en:Dewa Province|Dewa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} of [[:en:Dewa Province|Dewa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.
== Shikinaisha (式内社) ==
In the Engishiki, a list of major Shinto shrines is recorded – 2 groups (2 shrines, both of which are {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|Myojin Taisha|zh|Myojin Taisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) and 7 groups (7 minor shrines) for a total of 9 groups, 9 shrines.

== Shikigai Shrines (式外社) == Shrines that existed at the time of compiling the [[:en:Engishiki|Engishiki]] Kamimyōchō but are not recorded within it. * {{ill|Jōwa Shrine|de|Jōwa Shrine|ja|城輪神社|zh|城輪神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jōwa Shrine|qq=}}: In volume 10 of [[:en:Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku]], it is regarded as “Jōwa-gami”<ref group="脚注" name=sandai>[[:en:Jōgan|Jōgan]] 7th year, {{ill|2月27日 (old calendar)|de|2月27日 (old calendar)|ja|2月27日 (旧暦)|zh|2月27日 (旧历)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/2月27日 (old calendar)|qq=}} ([[:en:865|865]] [[:en:March 28|3月28日]]) clause “In Dewa Province, the primary shrine Ichinomiya of Jōwa deity is Ranked sixth and the attendant Takami deity is Ranked below fifth.”</ref>. * [[:en:Koshiō Shrine|Koshio Shrine]]: In volume 10 of [[:en:Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku]], it is identified as “Takami-kami”.<ref group="脚注" name=sandai/>

'''{{ill|Dewa no Shikinaisha Ichiran|de|Dewa no Shikinaisha Ichiran|ja|出羽国の式内社一覧|zh|出羽国の式内社一覧|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dewa no Shikinaisha Ichiran|qq=}}''' (Dewa no Kuni no Shikinaisha Ichiran) is a list of [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shrine]] – that is, the shrines recorded in the 9th and 10th volumes of the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}} (“Kamimyōchō Jōge”) – in addition to those shrines designated as {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|2=ja|3=式内社|qq=draft|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|2=ja|3=式内社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinaisha|13=User:Immanuelle|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|lt=Shikinaisha}} and their corresponding {{ill|Candidate Shrines|de|Kandidatschreine|ja|論社|1=candidate shrines|2=ja|3=論社|lt=candidate|zh|論社|1=candidate shrines|2=ja|3=論社|lt=candidate|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Candidate Shrines|13=User:Immanuelle/candidate shrines|1=Engishiki_Jinmyōchō#Ronsha|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki_Jinmyocho|lt=Ronsha}}}} that are classified as part of [[:en:Dewa Province|Dewa Province]].
It also includes shrines which, although they existed at the time of the compilation of the [[:en:Engishiki|Engishiki]], are not recorded in its Kamimyōchō – the so‐called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigai Shrines|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}”.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q11395784]] Wikidata name: (none) [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:53, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Dewa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[:en:Dewa Province|Dewa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} of [[:en:Dewa Province|Dewa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.
== Shikinaisha (式内社) ==
In the Engishiki, a list of major Shinto shrines is recorded – 2 groups (2 shrines, both of which are {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|Myojin Taisha|zh|Myojin Taisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) and 7 groups (7 minor shrines) for a total of 9 groups, 9 shrines.

It also includes shrines which, although they existed at the time of the compilation of the [[:en:Engishiki|Engishiki]], are not recorded in its Kamimyōchō – the so‐called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigai Shrines|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}”.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q11395784]] Wikidata name: (none) [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:53, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Dewa Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[:en:Dewa Province|Dewa Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} of [[:en:Dewa Province|Dewa Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.
== Shikinaisha (式内社) ==
In the Engishiki, a list of major Shinto shrines is recorded – 2 groups (2 shrines, both of which are {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|Myojin Taisha|zh|Myojin Taisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) and 7 groups (7 minor shrines) for a total of 9 groups, 9 shrines.

'''{{ill|Dewa no Shikinaisha Ichiran|de|Dewa no Shikinaisha Ichiran|ja|出羽国の式内社一覧|zh|出羽国の式内社一覧|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dewa no Shikinaisha Ichiran|qq=}}''' (Dewa no Kuni no Shikinaisha Ichiran) is a list of [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shrine]] – that is, the shrines recorded in the 9th and 10th volumes of the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}} (“Kamimyōchō Jōge”) – in addition to those shrines designated as {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|2=ja|3=式内社|qq=draft|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|2=ja|3=式内社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinaisha|13=User:Immanuelle|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|lt=Shikinaisha}} and their corresponding {{ill|Candidate Shrines|de|Kandidatschreine|ja|論社|1=candidate shrines|2=ja|3=論社|lt=candidate|zh|論社|1=candidate shrines|2=ja|3=論社|lt=candidate|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Candidate Shrines|13=User:Immanuelle/candidate shrines|1=Engishiki_Jinmyōchō#Ronsha|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki_Jinmyocho|lt=Ronsha}}}} that are classified as part of [[:en:Dewa Province|Dewa Province]].
It also includes shrines which, although they existed at the time of the compilation of the [[:en:Engishiki|Engishiki]], are not recorded in its Kamimyōchō – the so‐called “{{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigai Shrines|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 延喜式神名帳|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}”.
--> <!--jawiki derived wikidata interwikis--> [[Category:pages without english wikidata name]]

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shosha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shosha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shosha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shosha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shosha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shosha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shosha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shosha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shosha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shosha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shosha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shōsha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shōsha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shōsha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shosha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.

This is a list of Shikinaisha in [[Dewa Province]]. That is the shrines in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] in the province.

The Engishiki Jinmyōchō counts 9 Shikinaisha in the province – 7 Shikinai Shosha and 2 Shikinai Taisha.
